note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. Flags: this is a split engine, so the detector is pinned as expected.flaggedIssues via flagsHint "detectFlaggedIssues" with flagsArgs ["state","result.correctedCalciumRaw"], mirroring form-app.js's call detectFlaggedIssues(state, grade.correctedCalciumRaw); the wall clock is frozen at the oracle's default while grading.

personas.name: normal-with-normal-albumin
personas.description: Routine general-practice bloods, albumin within normal range: total calcium 2.30 mmol/L, albumin 40 g/L — no correction needed, corrected calcium 2.30 mmol/L, normal.

firedRules.description: Corrected calcium within 2.20–2.60 mmol/L — normal adult reference range

personas.name: hypocalcaemia-mild
personas.description: Post-thyroidectomy ward review with low albumin: total calcium 1.95 mmol/L, albumin 30 g/L — corrected calcium 2.15 mmol/L, below the 2.20 lower limit but not severe.

flaggedIssues.description: Corrected calcium 2.15 mmol/L below the 2.20 mmol/L lower reference limit
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Investigate the cause (vitamin D, magnesium, renal, parathyroid) and correlate with symptoms.

personas.name: severe-hypocalcaemia-symptomatic
personas.description: Emergency department presentation with perioral tingling and carpopedal spasm: total calcium 1.60 mmol/L, normal albumin — corrected calcium 1.60 mmol/L, below the 1.9 severe threshold, urgent.

flaggedIssues.description: Corrected calcium 1.60 mmol/L below the 1.9 mmol/L severe threshold — risk of tetany, seizures, arrhythmia
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Urgent: seek immediate review, check ECG and magnesium, and consider intravenous calcium replacement per local policy.

flaggedIssues.description: Corrected calcium 1.60 mmol/L below the 2.20 mmol/L lower reference limit
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Investigate the cause (vitamin D, magnesium, renal, parathyroid) and correlate with symptoms.

personas.name: hypercalcaemia-mild-asymptomatic
personas.description: Incidental finding on routine outpatient bloods: total calcium 2.70 mmol/L, normal albumin — corrected calcium 2.70 mmol/L, above the 2.60 upper limit but asymptomatic and not severe.

flaggedIssues.description: Corrected calcium 2.70 mmol/L above the 2.60 mmol/L upper reference limit
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Investigate the cause (parathyroid, malignancy, drugs) and correlate with symptoms.

personas.name: severe-hypercalcaemia-crisis
personas.description: Malignancy-associated hypercalcaemia on the oncology ward: total calcium 3.20 mmol/L, normal albumin — corrected calcium 3.20 mmol/L, at or above the 3.0 severe threshold, hypercalcaemic crisis risk.

note.clinicalNote: Confusion, polyuria; known metastatic breast cancer

flaggedIssues.description: Corrected calcium 3.20 mmol/L at or above the 3.0 mmol/L severe threshold — risk of hypercalcaemic crisis
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Urgent: seek immediate senior / endocrine review, monitor ECG and fluids, and treat per local hypercalcaemia protocol.

flaggedIssues.description: Corrected calcium 3.20 mmol/L above 2.60 mmol/L with reported symptoms
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Escalate; correlate polyuria, confusion, and arrhythmia, and investigate the cause of hypercalcaemia.

flaggedIssues.description: Corrected calcium 3.20 mmol/L above the 2.60 mmol/L upper reference limit
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Investigate the cause (parathyroid, malignancy, drugs) and correlate with symptoms.

personas.name: incomplete-missing-albumin
personas.description: Laboratory result pending: total calcium back but albumin not yet resulted — the correction cannot be applied and the classification is unknown, not assumed normal.

note.clinicalNote: Albumin pending, will re-run once available

firedRules.description: Correction not computed — total calcium and/or albumin is missing

flaggedIssues.description: Missing input(s): serum albumin — no corrected calcium can be computed
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Record the measured total calcium and serum albumin, then re-calculate.
